exposure: anesthesiologist staffing ratio (number of overlapping operations an anesthesiologist covers)
cohort: The study included 866,453 adult patients (aged >=18 years) undergoing major noncardiac inpatient surgical procedures within the Multicenter Perioperative Outcomes Group electronic health record registry.
finding: Increasing anesthesiologist coverage responsibilities (i.e., higher staffing ratios) was associated with an increase in risk-adjusted surgical patient morbidity and mortality.
